editorial.blurb: Wei Dao Cheng Du brings authentic Sichuan cuisine to Chicago with remarkably fresh ingredients, vibrant spice, and a welcoming modern dining space.
editorial.insiderTip: Order dishes in small sizes—they're already generous, and you'll have room to try more. Ask for 'Less Spicy' if heat isn't your preference; the kitchen adjusts perfectly.

topDishes.note: Incredibly fresh and tender fish, mild heat despite the name
Delicious and works with any protein in the dry pot style
Tender bass in an authentically spicy and fragrant broth
